what: a bearded bronze axe: a narrow-necked cast warm orange-brown bronze head with a golden sheen whose lower edge drops into a long hooked beard, a near-white edge highlight, on a long handle wrapped in red-brown leather with gold cross-bands and a round gold pommel, a gold collar band where head meets handle, lying diagonally, handle at the bottom left, head at the top right, filling the canvas corner to corner
